# GitHub Repository Files Manifest

This directory contains GitHub-native issue and pull-request forms for the public repository. Keep templates factual, focused on reproducible reports, and aligned with `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `SUPPORT.md`, and `SECURITY.md`.

> **Note:** `.github/` intentionally does **not** contain a `README.md` file because GitHub's repository homepage precedence (`1. .github/README.md` -> `2. /README.md` -> `3. docs/README.md`) renders `.github/README.md` in place of the root `/README.md`.

| Path                                 | Purpose                                                        |
| ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `MANIFEST.md`                        | Purpose, safe-submission rules, and inventory of `.github/`    |
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug-report.yml`      | Structured reproducible bug reports                            |
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature-request.yml` | Structured product and engine feature proposals                |
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml`          | Issue-template routing and private support links               |
| `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`           | Change scope, verification, and security checklist             |
